questions.q: What did the Most High call Abram to leave?
choices: His country, his kindred and his father's house
questions.explain: He called Abraham alone, and blessed him, and increased him (Isaiah 51:2). Do not let your kindred hold you back.

questions.q: Who are the 'families of the earth' blessed in Abraham's seed, according to the class?
choices: Scattered Israel, the children of the prophets and of the covenant, in all nations
questions.explain: Ye are the children of the prophets and of the covenant (Acts 3:25-26); Israel would be scattered into all nations.

questions.q: How old was Abram when he departed into Canaan?
questions.explain: Abram departed at seventy and five years old, with Sarai and Lot, into the land of Canaan.

questions.q: Why did the Lord plague Pharaoh and his house?
choices: Because Pharaoh refused to let Israel go
questions.explain: The Most High protected the household of Abram in Egypt.
